title: transcript.line.v1: one line of a session's transcript
description: PUBLIC record. A PROJECTION of event.v1 for a linear reader (the terminal client's plain mode, a screen reader, a golden file in a test). It is not the wire event and carries less: events.read and events.follow with projection 'transcript' return these lines (with projection 'raw' they return the events), one line for each event in order. The mapping from an event: seq is the event's seq. time_rel_ms is the event's time minus the time of the first event of the session's log, in milliseconds (in a test, from the test clock), and never less than the line before it: when the clock steps back, a line keeps the value of the line before, so the time of a transcript never runs backwards and is never negative. conformance/rules.py, transcript_fields, states the mapping of seq, time_rel_ms, event_type, source, trust, state and the event's own text as code, and the vectors in vectors/transcript.projection pair logs with their lines. event_type, source and trust are the event's type, source and trust. state is the state word the event reports, or null: for state.changed the entity's state in the post-image (for a run, the control record's state, or the daemon row's when there is no control record); for turn.ended its outcome; for approval.answered its state; for stop.result its code; for steer.queued its state; for interrupt its outcome; null for every other type. text is the event's text for a reader, or null when the event has none: for engine.output and turn.started the payload's text; for tool.result its text (null when the output was put aside); for result its detail; for approval.requested the request's rendered lines joined by line breaks; for every other type a short sentence written by the core's own renderer from the payload's typed fields. Text that came from an engine or a plugin is passed through the core's sanitizer and stays marked 'untrusted' (the sanitizer's own rule is not part of this record; plain text, which is printable ASCII, tabs and line feeds, passes through it unchanged); no line with trust 'untrusted' may open an approval. speech is what a screen reader is asked to say for this line, or null when nothing is to be announced (a condition is announced when it appears, changes or clears, not on every line). focus names where input goes after this line ('composer', 'approval', 'transcript', 'list'), or null when the line does not move it.
